subject: Demo rotation + staggered handoff for Dedicated/Private — EU DPO & APAC security review
messages:
From: Aditya Kumar <aditya.kumar@medica-eu.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers and windows

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier this week. Medica is close to an internal OK to trial a dedicated/private deployment but the security and privacy reviewers need a combined walkthrough that covers runtime isolation, key management, and audit logs.

We have two regional reviewers to include: Marie Dubois (EU DPO) and Kenji Sato (APAC security lead). Both requested short technical segments (20–30m) focused on data handling and SOC2 evidence. Can we propose a single 90-minute session with staggered handoffs so each reviewer joins during their local business hours? DST is a pain here — Marie is in CET, Kenji in JST.

High-level asks:
- 30m runtime + KMS discussion (technical)
- 20m SOC2 evidence and logging (compliance)
- 20m Q&A and next steps (mutual action plan)

Attached: high-level scope and an initial mutual action plan.

Best,
Aditya
Head of Infrastructure Programs, Medica Therapeutics

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Kumar <aditya.kumar@medica-eu.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers and windows

Thanks Aditya — this is doable. Laura, Monica, Ben — looping you all in so we can staff the right segments. Monica can lead runtime/KMS and Ben will cover SOC2/logging.

To work around DST differences, I suggest a rotating window approach where the meeting runs 90 minutes UTC-aligned and each region joins the portion that matches their day. Proposed slots (all are start times in UTC):

Option A: 13:00 UTC (07:00 PDT / 14:00 CET / 22:00 JST) — early for APAC, likely late for Kenji
Option B: 15:00 UTC (09:00 PDT / 16:00 CET / 00:00+1 JST) — better for EU, awkward for APAC
Option C: 08:00 UTC (01:00 PDT / 09:00 CET / 17:00 JST) — good overlap for APAC evening and EU morning

My gut says Option C gives Kenji an evening slot and Marie a morning slot — fewer people have to join outside business hours. Laura — do you have any constraints on Tuesday/Wednesday next week?

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF)

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@medica-eu.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T16:48:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers and windows

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the options. For the EU DPO office, mornings are much preferred (09:00–12:30 CET). Option C looks promising but can we make sure the SOC2 evidence review is scheduled in the middle (so I don't have to join the entire 90m if my schedule shifts)? Marie

Notes:
- I will want a short pre-read of the SOC2 snapshot and log retention policy (PDF or zipped artifacts).
- Please include names of the engineers who will answer architecture questions.

Best,
Marie Dubois
Data Protection Officer, Medica Therapeutics

Attachment request: soc2-snapshot.zip (requested)
From: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tokai-biotech.jp>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Kumar <aditya.kumar@medica-eu.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T02:12:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers and windows

Hello — thank you for coordinating. JST team prefers later-in-day meetings (16:00–19:00 JST). Option C (08:00 UTC) maps to 17:00 JST and works for me, but our CTO might only join for the first 30 minutes. If possible, can the runtime/KMS segment be scheduled in the first 30–40 minutes so the CTO hears architecture and key management?

Also: APAC compliance team would like any recorded demo (we understand if recording is limited) and a one-page summary of audit log retention policies.

Regards,
Kenji Sato
Security Lead, Tokai Biotech (APAC reviewer)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Kumar <aditya.kumar@medica-eu.com>, Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@medica-eu.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tokai-biotech.jp>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers and windows

Thanks everyone — Monica from Redwood here. Quick alignment and firm proposal below.

Proposed schedule (90 minutes, Option C time base):
- 08:00 UTC / 17:00 JST / 09:00 CET (start) — intro and attendee quick intros (5m)
- 08:05–08:35 UTC — runtime + KMS (Monica + engineering lead) (30m)
- 08:35–08:55 UTC — SOC2 evidence & log retention (Ben) (20m)
- 08:55–09:15 UTC — Q&A, next steps, mutual action plan (Vivek) (20m)

Dates we can staff next week: Tuesday 2026-10-19 or Wednesday 2026-10-20. Please confirm which date works for the Medica reviewers and whether recording/summary PDFs OK. We will upload the SOC2 snapshot and a one-page retention summary to the Drive link beforehand.

Action items for Medica:
- Marie: confirm you only need the middle SOC2 block if your schedule requires it.
- Kenji: confirm your CTO can attend the first 30m or whether we should swap runtime/KMS earlier (we can be flexible).

Thanks — Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: (we will upload soc2-snapshot.zip and a one-pager to the Drive link)
From: Aditya Kumar <aditya.kumar@medica-eu.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@medica-eu.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tokai-biotech.jp>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T21:12:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers and windows

Monica / Vivek — thanks, that schedule works. We confirm Wednesday 2026-10-20 for the 08:00 UTC session.

Quick confirmations:
- Marie: will join for SOC2 block and appreciates the pre-read (we will download from Drive).
- Kenji: CTO will join the first 30m; please keep runtime/KMS in first 30m as suggested.
- Recording: Medica ok with recording for internal review; please notify participants at start.

We'll review the mutual action plan this week and post any follow-ups to the HubSpot deal. Thanks for working through the DSTs — appreciate the rotation approach.

Best,
Aditya
Head of Infrastructure Programs, Medica Therapeutics
